defaults.summary: MySQL, one database and account per group.

runtime.initialise:
set -eu
umask 077
case "${MYSQL_ADMIN_PASSWORD:-}" in
  '' | *[!0-9a-f]*) printf '%s\n' 'the administrator password is not hexadecimal' >&2; exit 1 ;;
esac
if [ -e "$STACK_DATA_DIR/mysql-data" ]; then
  printf '%s\n' 'mysql-data exists without its system tablespace; preserve it and choose an empty instance directory.' >&2
  exit 1
fi
building="$STACK_DATA_DIR/mysql-data.initialising"
init_file="$STACK_DATA_DIR/initialise.sql"
trap 'rm -f "$init_file"' EXIT
rm -rf "$building"
printf "CREATE USER 'stack_admin'@'localhost' IDENTIFIED BY '%s';\nGRANT ALL ON *.* TO 'stack_admin'@'localhost' WITH GRANT OPTION;\nDROP USER 'root'@'localhost';\n" "$MYSQL_ADMIN_PASSWORD" > "$init_file"
"$STACK_INSTALL_DIR/bin/mysqld" --no-defaults --initialize-insecure --basedir="$STACK_INSTALL_DIR" --datadir="$building" --init-file="$init_file" --skip-log-bin --mysqlx=OFF
mv "$building" "$STACK_DATA_DIR/mysql-data"
runtime.start:
umask 077
case "${1:-}" in
  --defaults-file=*) ;;
  *) set -- --no-defaults ;;
esac
mkdir -p "$STACK_DATA_DIR/files"
exec "$STACK_INSTALL_DIR/bin/mysqld" "$@" --basedir="$STACK_INSTALL_DIR" --datadir="$STACK_DATA_DIR/mysql-data" --bind-address=127.0.0.1 --port="$STACK_PORT" --socket="$STACK_SOCKET_DIR/mysqld.sock" --mysqlx=OFF --skip-log-bin --skip-name-resolve --local-infile=OFF --secure-file-priv="$STACK_DATA_DIR/files" --pid-file="$STACK_DATA_DIR/mysqld.pid"

runtime.group_rename:
{snippet:admin}
{snippet:label}
label "$STACK_OLD_GROUP" 'the old group name'
label "$STACK_GROUP" 'the group name'
old="$STACK_OLD_GROUP"
new="$STACK_GROUP"
objects="$(printf "SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.VIEWS WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = '%s')
  + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TRIGGERS WHERE TRIGGER_SCHEMA = '%s')
  + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.ROUTINES WHERE ROUTINE_SCHEMA = '%s')
  + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.EVENTS WHERE EVENT_SCHEMA = '%s');\n" "$old" "$old" "$old" "$old" | admin)"
[ "$objects" = 0 ] || refuse "the group's database holds views, triggers, routines or events, which MySQL cannot move to another database; dump the database, drop them, and restore the dump after the rename"
problem="$(printf "SELECT CASE
  WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM mysql.db WHERE Db = '%s' AND User NOT IN ('%s', '%s'))
    THEN 'the new group name has a database another account may use; inspect existing state'
  ELSE '' END;\n" "$new" "$old" "$new" | admin)"
[ -z "$problem" ] || refuse "$problem"
if [ "$(printf "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.SCHEMATA WHERE SCHEMA_NAME = '%s';\n" "$old" | admin)" = 1 ]; then
  printf "SET SESSION group_concat_max_len = 1073741824;
CREATE DATABASE IF NOT EXISTS \`%s\`;
SET @moves = (SELECT CONCAT('RENAME TABLE ', GROUP_CONCAT(CONCAT('\`%s\`.\`', REPLACE(TABLE_NAME, '\`', '\`\`'), '\` TO \`%s\`.\`', REPLACE(TABLE_NAME, '\`', '\`\`'), '\`') SEPARATOR ', '))
  FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_SCHEMA = '%s' AND TABLE_TYPE = 'BASE TABLE');
SET @moves = COALESCE(@moves, 'DO 0');
PREPARE moving FROM @moves;
EXECUTE moving;
DEALLOCATE PREPARE moving;
DROP DATABASE \`%s\`;\n" "$new" "$old" "$new" "$old" "$old" | admin
fi
if [ "$(printf "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mysql.user WHERE User IN ('%s', '%s') AND Host = '%%';\n" "$old" "$new" | admin)" = 1 ] &&
  [ "$(printf "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mysql.user WHERE User = '%s' AND Host = '%%';\n" "$old" | admin)" = 1 ]; then
  printf "RENAME USER '%s'@'%%' TO '%s'@'%%';\n" "$old" "$new" | admin
fi
if [ "$(printf "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mysql.user WHERE User = '%s' AND Host = '%%';\n" "$new" | admin)" = 1 ]; then
  printf "GRANT ALL ON \`%s\`.* TO '%s'@'%%';\nREVOKE IF EXISTS ALL ON \`%s\`.* FROM '%s'@'%%';\n" "$new" "$new" "$old" "$new" | admin
fi
runtime.database_rename:
{snippet:admin}
{snippet:account-name}
account_name "$STACK_OLD_DATABASE_USER" 'the old database account'
account_name "$STACK_DATABASE_USER" 'the database account'
old="$STACK_OLD_DATABASE_USER"
new="$STACK_DATABASE_USER"
if [ "$(printf "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mysql.user WHERE User IN ('%s', '%s') AND Host = '%%';\n" "$old" "$new" | admin)" = 1 ] &&
  [ "$(printf "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mysql.user WHERE User = '%s' AND Host = '%%';\n" "$old" | admin)" = 1 ]; then
  objects="$(printf "SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.VIEWS WHERE DEFINER = '%s@%%')
  + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TRIGGERS WHERE DEFINER = '%s@%%')
  + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.ROUTINES WHERE DEFINER = '%s@%%')
  + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.EVENTS WHERE DEFINER = '%s@%%');\n" "$old" "$old" "$old" "$old" | admin)"
  [ "$objects" = 0 ] || refuse "the database account $old defines views, triggers, routines or events, whose DEFINER would name an account that no longer exists after the rename; dump its database, drop them, and restore the dump after the rename"
  printf "RENAME USER '%s'@'%%' TO '%s'@'%%';\n" "$old" "$new" | admin
fi

notes.name: accounts
notes.text: The server listens on 127.0.0.1 only. Each account holds every privilege on its own database and none elsewhere, and Stack's administrator, stack_admin, signs in only through the instance's socket. The mysql client takes no user from the environment, so outside stack db shell run mysql -u "$DB_USERNAME" "$DB_DATABASE".

notes.name: group_rename
notes.text: A group rename moves its database's tables to the new name, and is refused while that database holds views, triggers, routines or events, which MySQL cannot move. An explicit database keeps its name but its account is renamed, so the rename is also refused while that account defines a view, trigger, routine or event, whose DEFINER would name an account that no longer exists; dump the database, drop those objects, and restore the dump after the rename.

notes.name: restore
notes.text: stack db restore and stack db clone replay a mysqldump file as the database's own account, without its DEFINER clauses; a file that names another database or needs administrator privileges is refused, and a failed restore keeps what it replayed, because MySQL commits each table definition at once.

notes.name: versions
notes.text: A newer release upgrades the data directory in place when it starts; an older release cannot open it again, so dump the databases before moving an instance to a newer version.

recipes.title: Laravel with MySQL and Valkey
recipes.gives: Gives the site DATABASE_URL, the DB_* variables and DB_CONNECTION=mysql, and the REDIS_* variables; service-prefixed copies such as DB_DATABASE_URL come too, and mysql joins the shell with MYSQL_HOST, MYSQL_TCP_PORT and MYSQL_PWD.

recipes.title: Several databases on one server
recipes.yaml:
group: shop
services:
  - name: db
    type: mysql
    databases:
      - {name: app, env_prefix: ""}
      - {name: wallet, env_prefix: WALLET}
recipes.gives: Gives DATABASE_URL and the DB_* variables for app, and the same names prefixed WALLET_ for wallet, such as WALLET_DATABASE_URL; each database has its own account.

recipes.title: One server shared by several groups
recipes.gives: Gives shop DATABASE_URL and the DB_* variables, served by one MySQL process for every group naming shared: local; no group can open another's database.

recipes.title: Server settings from the repository
recipes.yaml:
group: shop
services:
  - name: db
    type: mysql
    config: [config/mysql/dev.cnf]
recipes.gives: Reads config/mysql/dev.cnf, such as a [mysqld] group setting max_connections = 50, after Stack's main file; Stack refuses the settings it keeps for itself, listed under CONFIG FILES.

snippets.provision-account:
case "$DB_PASSWORD" in
  '' | *[!0-9a-f]*) refuse 'the account password is not hexadecimal' ;;
esac
problem="$(printf "SELECT CASE
  WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM mysql.user WHERE User = '%s' AND Host = '%%')
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.USER_ATTRIBUTES WHERE USER = '%s' AND HOST = '%%'
      AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(ATTRIBUTE, '\$.stack')) = '%s')
    THEN 'the account belongs to another owner; inspect existing state'
  WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.USER_PRIVILEGES WHERE GRANTEE = '''%s''@''%%''' AND PRIVILEGE_TYPE <> 'USAGE')
    OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM mysql.role_edges WHERE (FROM_USER = '%s' AND FROM_HOST = '%%') OR (TO_USER = '%s' AND TO_HOST = '%%'))
    THEN 'the account has privileges Stack did not give it; inspect existing state'
  WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.SCHEMATA WHERE SCHEMA_NAME = '%s')
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM mysql.db WHERE Db = '%s' AND User = '%s' AND Host = '%%')
    THEN 'database belongs to another owner; inspect existing state'
  WHEN EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM mysql.db WHERE Db = '%s' AND NOT (User = '%s' AND Host = '%%'))
    THEN 'database access grants conflict; inspect existing state'
  ELSE '' END;\n" "$account" "$account" "$kind" "$account" "$account" "$account" "$database" "$database" "$account" "$database" "$account" | admin)"
[ -z "$problem" ] || refuse "$problem"
printf "CREATE USER IF NOT EXISTS '%s'@'%%' IDENTIFIED BY '%s' ATTRIBUTE '{\"stack\": \"%s\"}';
ALTER USER '%s'@'%%' IDENTIFIED BY '%s';
GRANT ALL ON \`%s\`.* TO '%s'@'%%';
CREATE DATABASE IF NOT EXISTS \`%s\`;\n" "$account" "$DB_PASSWORD" "$kind" "$account" "$DB_PASSWORD" "$database" "$account" "$database" | admin
rm -rf "$STACK_DATA_DIR/accounts"
snippets.target-owned:
label "$STACK_DATABASE" 'the database name'
account_name "$STACK_DATABASE_USER" 'the database account'
problem="$(printf "SELECT CASE
  WHEN NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.USER_ATTRIBUTES WHERE USER = '%s' AND HOST = '%%'
    AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(ATTRIBUTE, '\$.stack')) IN ('group', 'database'))
    THEN 'the database account does not exist; run stack up to provision it'
  WHEN '%s' IN ('mysql', 'information_schema', 'performance_schema', 'sys')
    OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.SCHEMATA WHERE SCHEMA_NAME = '%s')
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM mysql.db WHERE Db = '%s' AND User = '%s' AND Host = '%%')
    THEN 'database belongs to another owner; inspect existing state'
  ELSE '' END;\n" "$STACK_DATABASE_USER" "$STACK_DATABASE" "$STACK_DATABASE" "$STACK_DATABASE" "$STACK_DATABASE_USER" | admin)"
[ -z "$problem" ] || refuse "$problem"
snippets.replay:
[ -n "${STACK_DATABASE_PASSWORD:-}" ] || refuse 'Stack passed no password for the database account'
failed="$STACK_DATA_DIR/replay-failed.$$"
trap 'rm -f "$failed"' EXIT
replay() {
  { LC_ALL=C sed '/^INSERT INTO /!s/DEFINER=`[^`]*`@`[^`]*`//g' || : > "$failed"; } |
    MYSQL_PWD="$STACK_DATABASE_PASSWORD" "$STACK_INSTALL_DIR/bin/mysql" --no-defaults --protocol=SOCKET --socket="$STACK_SOCKET_DIR/mysqld.sock" --user="$STACK_DATABASE_USER" --batch --binary-mode --database="$STACK_DATABASE"
  [ ! -e "$failed" ] || refuse "$1"
}
